summary: Planning-only draft for a future ranked Legacy Upgrade Catalog. Entries are not live unlock definitions and must not be imported by gameplay.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Very small future-character HP readiness increments from account Legacy, weaker per point than temporary preparations.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: At thresholds, unlock related presentation or narrow recovery-side options instead of large direct HP jumps.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires a typed character-start stat-source budget before any rank can become live.
entries.notes: No full tank specialization at creation; keep below normal equipment and class identity impact.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Tiny starting stamina increments for early travel and work safety.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds may unlock modest fatigue clarity or preparation synergies, not large endurance pools.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires character-start resource-source accounting and balance caps.
entries.notes: Must not change current fresh-run resource fill behavior until a later runtime pass.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Small starting wallet bump for convenience purchases without bypassing early economy pressure.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds can unlock budgeting previews or starting-vendor clarity rather than large currency grants.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires starter economy budget and save metadata source labeling.
entries.notes: Must not affect current run-end payout math or account balances.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Permit modest starter skill floor or cap flexibility only after skill-start budgets exist.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds unlock additional eligible skill families, not full trained ranks.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires data-driven skill-start source caps and anti-specialization limits.
entries.notes: No character should start with complete specialization from this track.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Increase the number of next-run preparations in small steps.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds may unlock preparation organization or category caps, not free preparation effects.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Current system has a preparation-capacity precedent; future ranks need new balance limits before migration.
entries.notes: Draft ranks are not the live capacity table.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Modest readiness for route planning, weather awareness, or tiny travel-supply starts.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds add horizontal travel information such as route warnings or packing suggestions.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires engine-owned travel prep hooks and authored route risk projection.
entries.notes: Do not reduce actual travel costs or hazards until travel runtime owns those effects.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Small recovery-readiness support such as better starting care knowledge or one modest starter supply.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds unlock better injury feedback or recovery planning options.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires recovery/injury runtime ownership before any gameplay effect is activated.
entries.notes: Must not change current run-start HP, stamina, or MP fill behavior.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Future family-level reputation, introductions, and soft access flags.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds unlock broader household recognition, not direct combat or economy power.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires family ledger storage and household ownership semantics.
entries.notes: Design-only until family balances and ownership records exist.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Family remembers trusted crafts, routes, and merchant habits as small unlock hints.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds add horizontal starter-bundle or contact options.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires family ledger storage plus source-linked archived-run contributions.
entries.notes: Must not become a generic economy simulator inside account Legacy.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Small region-bound social recognition and local service familiarity.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds unlock local introductions or public-history presentation.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires region-bound ownership storage and region-scoped earning rules.
entries.notes: No current account balance should spend or store regional renown.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Unlock region-specific route aid or safer introduction options once route ownership exists.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds broaden eligible route families without reducing hazards globally.
entries.prerequisitesIntent: Requires cartography, region ownership, and route access contracts.
entries.notes: Region-bound and design-only.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Retain small amounts of discovered lore visibility across characters.
entries.breakthroughEffectIntent: Thresholds add horizontal recall categories rather than direct skill power.

entries.normalEffectIntent: Retain region descriptions, hazards, and service hints in modest bands.
